title: Rokid and Alipay launch look-to-pay on Rokid Glasses (12 MP QR scanning)
detail: Rokid and Alipay launch the "看一下支付" (look-to-pay) feature on Rokid Glasses, using a 12 MP camera to scan Alipay QR codes. Shows why close-range autofocus matters for QR payment.

title: Rokid gen-2 display AI glasses shown in Hangzhou; formal launch 2026-10-27; no AF wording
detail: Rokid gen-2 display AI glasses shown in Hangzhou; formal launch 2026-10-27. Upgrades: stabilisation and night mode; no AF wording. Second source: http://news.10jqka.com.cn/20260929/c680355614.shtml
